matter_background.original: Gayan Alwis is a Notary licensed to practice within the High Court Jurisdiction of Galle. His client Anura Fernando wishes to purchase a property in Ratnapura from a person living there who is unable to travel to Galle due to ill health to execute the Deed.

(ii) Gayan Alwis is a Notary licensed to practice within the High Court Jurisdiction of Galle. His client Anura Fernando wishes to purchase a property in Ratnapura from a person living there who is unable to travel to Galle due to ill health to execute the Deed.
